evidence: The March 15 UMG notice describes an exploratory initiative.
The September 6 notice concerns a Deezer model, not industry-wide adoption.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: global earnings impact was not demonstrated by the checked sources.

review.note: Primary notices establish a March 15 exploration initiative and September 6 Deezer agreement, not the March 21 date or a worldwide December 2024 deadline. Unsupported Apple/Amazon agreements and universal higher-earnings claims must not survive the correction.

evidence: FIFA's age records contradict the claimed oldest-player outcome.

NFL reported his return on March 13.

Broken refers to the missed original target, not a finding that no agreement could ever follow.

Epic's July 31 post-event recap records the completed finals and US$30 million solo/duo prize pool. This assesses the announced event pool, not the settlement date of every winner's payment.

promise: "You might see a smaller jump from GPT-5 to GPT-6 than from GPT-4 to GPT-5" — signaling GPT-6 within roughly a year of GPT-5, i.e., 2026

evidence: GPT-5 launched Aug 7, 2025 (Wikipedia)
OpenAI shipped GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.6 by Dec 2025, latest models per Wikipedia's OpenAI/GPT-5 pages
No GPT-6 release or announcement found in news feeds as of July 2026
sources: The Verge: All of the updates from OpenAI DevDay 2025 (Oct 6, 2025)

review.note: Search found a September 2025 20VC newsletter, not evidence for the October 6 date, exact comparison, or a GPT-6 release deadline. OpenAI release notes do not substantiate the record's claimed GPT-5.6 release in December 2025. Do not convert a speculative model-gap comment into a dated launch promise.

evidence: The report concerns annual revenue, not an annualized run rate.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked report is a forecast, not audited 2025 results.

review.note: Reuters describes an anonymously sourced company forecast of $11.6 billion annual revenue, not an Altman quotation or annualized run rate. Its underlying report is dated September 27; the exact UTC publication day and date of the underlying forecast are not established. The claimed actual totals are not verified.

promise: Helion planned to bring its first fusion power plant online by 2028, targeting at least 50 MW after a one-year ramp-up.

evidence: Helion's announcement distinguishes the online date from the subsequent capacity target.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked announcement does not demonstrate commercial power delivery; the online target remains future.

evidence: Contemporary reporting dates the Davos remarks to January 21, 2025.
Reuters describes the later timetable as a delay from the 2025 target.

promise: Hassabis predicted that artificial general intelligence could emerge in roughly five to ten years.
description: Hassabis gave an approximate forecast for AGI at a March 2025 briefing. It is not a fixed end-of-2035 delivery commitment.
evidence: CNBC's summary reports a five-to-ten-year expectation, not an unconditional deadline.

review.note: This is an approximate five-to-ten-year forecast, not a guarantee that every task will be solved by December 2035. The source points to a March 17 briefing; the exact original article should be checked before converting the window to a precise daily deadline. Unsupported 2026 revisions are removed.

description: The essay presents a conditional early-arrival scenario, not a commitment to deliver a system by 2026.
evidence: The essay is dated October 2024 and expressly preserves uncertainty about timing.

review.note: The primary essay says October 2024, not October 10, and explicitly allows a much longer timeline. A possible earliest arrival in 2026 is not a latest deadline. Remove the invented compute-scale discussion and unsourced assertion about the state of all AI systems.

evidence: The primary announcement supports the year-end target, but its date differs from the contemporaneous model-card addendum.

Do not silently resolve that date discrepancy. The record's architecture claim and assertion that no 3.5 Opus ever shipped need release-history evidence.

evidence: The launch report was timestamped February 18, 2025 UTC.

review.note: The release was reported late February 17 US Pacific time, which is February 18 UTC. The July 1 original statement and its exact wording were not established; do not verify that placeholder. A late release is a missed target, not on-time partial fulfillment.

promise: xAI announced plans to expand Colossus to at least one million GPUs.

evidence: Reuters attributes the expansion announcement to the Greater Memphis Chamber.
The primary Memphis page supplies a different target year.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: a plan is not evidence of installed capacity.

review.note: Reuters supports the December 4 expansion announcement but not a 2027 deadline. The current primary Memphis page instead says by 2026, without establishing when that timetable was announced. Do not choose between these by invention; the newer target is relevant contrary evidence. The detailed interim GPU inventories are unverified.

promise: xAI stated its mission as understanding the true nature of the universe.
description: The company's July 12, 2023 launch presented a research mission, without a fulfillment date.
evidence: Contemporary launch coverage supports the mission and date, but no deadline or completed outcome.

review.note: A mission statement is not a dated deliverable and cannot be marked kept merely because it remains the mission. The original description itself admits the deadline is an assessment horizon; that is not a promised deadline. Withhold while the schema requires one.

evidence: NVIDIA describes Rubin as in full production and gives a later partner-availability window.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked primary notice does not establish actual partner-product availability.

review.note: The original conflates architecture cadence, production and partner availability. NVIDIA's later primary notice says Rubin is in production and partner products are expected in the second half of 2026. The March 2025 annual-cadence quotation and full Ultra target need primary confirmation before publication.

promise: Huang predicted that the worldwide installed value of data centers would grow from about $1 trillion to $2 trillion over four to five years.

evidence: The contemporary report describes a four-to-five-year forecast.
Earlier February 13 reporting shows February 14 cannot be assumed to be the speech date.

review.note: DCD's February 14 date is publication, not the Dubai speech date; February 13 coverage already reports the same remarks. Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the forecast horizon remains future.

evidence: Microsoft's announcement establishes the preview launch.

Neither it nor the contemporary report establishes a quantified market-share target or December 2025 deadline. A market-share comparison cannot turn launch rhetoric into a broken dated commitment; remove unsupported current shares and strategic-causation claims.

evidence: The October 30, 2024 earnings transcript sets the next-quarter forecast.

In the fiscal-Q2 results call, the CEO and CFO reported an AI revenue run rate above US$13 billion and above expectations. The fulfillment assessment uses the reported quarter, not January 29 as a substituted deadline.

Google's November 18 announcement establishes the launch.

evidence: The primary release gives the target, date and Benioff attribution.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked announcement does not provide a comparable count of empowered agents at the deadline.

evidence: IBM's roadmap labels the underlying plan May 2022.

evidence: The primary June 12 announcement identifies Helios and MI400.

World Bank hosts the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage

evidence: Russian gas imports cut by about 75% between 2021 and 2025
EU regulation banning Russian LNG from January 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027 approved in January 2026
National phase-out plans were due to the Commission by 1 March 2026
sources: PubAffairs Bruxelles / Council of the EU

Europe currently holds around 10% of the global semiconductor market
EU Chips Act entered into force 21 September 2023

Multiple investigations opened into suspected non-compliance after the deadline

Obligations applied from 25 August 2023 as scheduled
Full DSA application to all intermediary services followed on 17 February 2024

The record confuses a regulatory application date with a fulfilled commitment; actual compliance and the announcement-date interpretation remain unresolved.

3 countries completed the process; only 2 received debt relief
ONE analysis found the framework cut high-risk debt by only ~7%

Neither the precise December 2024 deadline nor the 7% debt-reduction metric is established. evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the agreement and planned schedule are supported, but country-by-country enactment and commencement were not reconciled.

Institute for Global Change found less than a third of G7 pledges reached Africa by mid-2022

No mechanism delivering the annual $500bn level existed as of 2026

CBC reported the Games cut carbon by over half compared with 2012 and 2016

Holmes convicted on four counts of investor fraud, January 2022

evidence: Lordstown's FY2022 results report three vehicle sales in Q4 2022 and subsequent customer use. Production and initial customer deliveries occurred after September 2021. This rating covers their commencement, not mass production, all reservations, or the planned 500-vehicle batch.

evidence: UST fell to ~$0.09 in May 2022 after weeks of trading below $1
Luna Foundation Guard moved 52,189 BTC to counterparties during the collapse

The alleged March 20 unconditional guarantee and an expiry of May 31 are not established; a perpetual peg is not a promise due on an arbitrary month end. Celsius filed Chapter 11 on 13 July 2022

Limited drone trials began only in 2022-2024

Ghosn admitted the 2016 target would be missed (November 2013)

BBC reported in December 2020 that flights would begin in 2021

evidence: Q4 2017 returned to growth, but FY2017 revenue was still down ~1%
IBM reported full-year revenue growth again in 2018

evidence: Q3 and Q4 FY2014 quarterly revenue grew year over year
Full-year FY2014 revenue still declined slightly; 2015 split disrupted the growth plan

Annual net losses continued; Chapter 11 filing October 2018

review.note: The $155-205 million range was preliminary guidance, not final quarterly profit. Actual attributable net income was $208 million. evidence: VW became the world's best-selling automaker in 2016 (10.3M vs Toyota 10.2M vehicles)
VW retained the top spot in 2017, ahead of the 2018 deadline

Chapter 11 filing November 2023

€100bn allocated to the Climate Transition Fund

No implementing measures were presented

Implementation status still pending as of mid-2026

BlackRock continued to hold major fossil-fuel assets, making full achievement uncertain as of 2026

evidence: Tesla omitted the 20-million target from its 2023 impact report
TechCrunch (July 2026): Musk 'abandoned that idea a few years ago'; Tesla made its 10 millionth EV

role: Telecommunications operator and its Pakistani subsidiary
promise: Invest USD 1 billion in Pakistan over the next three years to expand 5G connectivity and digital services
description: JazzWorld and VEON leadership reiterated the investment plan during their April 1, 2026 meeting with Pakistan's prime minister.
evidence: Jazz's dated company statement establishes the meeting, amount and three-year investment period; full deployment was not established.

role: IT services subsidiary of Samsung Group
promise: Plan KRW 10 trillion in investment by 2031 across AI, robotics and related strategic investments
description: Samsung SDS CEO Lee June-hee reiterated the investment strategy at the September 8, 2026 REAL Summit in Seoul, including acquisitions and equity investments.
evidence: Yonhap's dated press-conference report establishes the amount and 2031 horizon; the corporate release confirms the event.

role: South Korean shipbuilder and engine maker
promise: Invest KRW 1.0722 trillion in engine and SMR-component facilities, supporting a target of 7.2 GW annual HiMSEN capacity by 2030
description: The September 10, 2026 disclosure allocates KRW 833.6 billion to the engine facility and KRW 238.6 billion to SMR components. It targets engine-plant completion in May 2028, SMR completion in first-half 2029 and total engine capacity of 7.2 GW by 2030.
evidence: The company release states separate facility schedules and a 2030 combined marine and land-based engine-capacity target.

promise: Invest more than $2 billion in Latin American programming and sports rights between 2027 and 2030
description: Prime Video said it would spend more than $2 billion on original and licensed programming and live sports rights across Latin America between 2027 and 2030, more than doubling its local original output across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Chile and releasing more than 25 new titles in 2027 alone.
evidence: Announcement of August 20, 2026
Commitment covers 2027-2030 across five Latin American markets

promise: Establish at least one functional national emergency medical team in each WHO African Region member state by 2030
description: The regional committee adopted an emergency-medical-team framework during its August 2026 session. The framework targets nationally owned, deployable teams by 2030.
evidence: WHO reports adoption and progress in individual countries, not universal completion; exact adoption day remains unresolved.

review.note: The commitment covers WHO African Region member states, not every AU country. The September 7 story reports August adoption; the provisional agenda places discussion August 27 but is not proof of the final vote date. September 9 is unsupported and cannot simply be replaced with a publication date.

role: Humanitarian agencies and the Lebanese government
promise: Appeal for USD 426 million to support about one million conflict-affected people in Lebanon during October-December 2024
description: The Lebanese government and UN launched the appeal on October 1, 2024. The amount represented provisional humanitarian funding requirements, dependent on donor contributions.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the launch record identifies the original appeal and period, but a reconciled final funding and assistance outcome for that appeal was not retrieved; separate 2026 appeals cannot establish it.

role: Indian subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Group
promise: Reach 20 percent women in its executive workforce by 2030
description: Hyundai Motor India announced a target on September 7, 2026 for women to represent 20% of its executive workforce by 2030.
evidence: The company announcement supports the date, target, denominator and 2030 horizon.

promise: End the double-track system in senior high schools by the end of 2027.
description: Mahama set a year-end 2027 target for ending the system that alternates student attendance to accommodate limited school capacity.
evidence: The presidency documented the commitment on September 11; Ghana News Agency reported a subsequent reiteration. These sources establish the target, not its fulfillment.

promise: Target commissioning the SDD-UBIDS library complex in 2027.
description: During a university visit, Mahama said he looked forward to commissioning the library complex in 2027. The due date represents the end of that stated target year, not an announced ceremony date.
evidence: The university's account of the September 12 visit records the 2027 target. Completion has not been established.
sources: SDD University of Business and Integrated Development Studies

role: Federal government led by Prime Minister Mark Carney
promise: Double Canada's preferential trade-market access over the next six months.
description: The Prime Minister's Office stated a six-month market-access target alongside the Canada Investment Summit. The due date is six calendar months after the announcement.
evidence: The official release states the target while describing existing trade agreements and prospective access from ASEAN to India; it does not demonstrate that the expansion has already happened.

promise: Provide C$150 billion in financing over five years to support Canadian economic growth.
description: TD announced a five-year financing commitment covering lending, underwriting and advisory activity. This is not a pledge to invest the full amount as the bank's own cash. The due date is the five-year anniversary of the announcement.
evidence: TD's September 14 announcement establishes the commitment; the Prime Minister's Office included it in the September 15 summit summary. Fulfillment remains pending.

promise: Aim to invest an additional C$10 billion in Canada by the end of 2027, subject to investment-return objectives.
description: The pension fund set a conditional investment objective, not an unconditional spending guarantee. Investments remain subject to its return requirements.
evidence: The fund's September 11 announcement states the amount, end-2027 horizon and return condition; Canada's summit release subsequently reported the commitment.
